subject: bone:bp-bony-pelvis
claim: Pas de cavite cotyloide ni de branches pubiennes visibles, l'ensemble ressemble a un sacrum.

sources.name: NCBI Bookshelf StatPearls — Pelvis Bones
sources.excerpt: The pelvis consists of right and left hip bones, each formed by the pubis, ischium and ilium, with the sacrum and coccyx; the acetabulum is a hemispherical concavity.

sources.name: Kenhub — The Pelvis
sources.excerpt: The lateral surface of the hip bone houses the acetabulum; the ischium and pubis form the obturator foramen and pubic rami.

reasoning: Un pelvis osseux complet comprend les os coxaux avec acetabulum et rami pubiens, plus sacrum et coccyx. Le maillage observe ne presente pas ces elements.
recommendation: A valider avant exclusion ou renommage ; ne pas reconstruire de geometrie.
